OMG - vego Bahn mi with garlic!
Apr 2018 • Family
Came upon this hole in the wall place whilst returning from Hanoi Markets. I sought the opinions of a family sitting just inside who said their teenage son was on his second, and confirmed the product as “delicious”. Relying on this WOM, I ordered the vegetarian with garlic and watched awestruck as they chopped two teaspoons of garlic which (mercifully) they deep fried. The filled sandwich was baked in a solid fuel oven, but this simply crisped the downy soft baguette to a perfect textural match for the filling. I gave my wife (who loves garlic) a bite, and she said it “pushed her boundaries”. An absolute bombshell sandwich, which I can highly recommend. Going back for the vego/egg before I leave.
